scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm for this repo.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.prepare: node ./scripts/manage_scummvm_assets.mjs validate && node ./scripts/generate-runtime-assets.mjs && pnpm run generate:artwork && node ./scripts/manage_scummvm_assets.mjs sync scummvm-shell public && node ./scripts/manage_scummvm_assets.mjs validate public && node ./scripts/generate-game-progress.mjs && pnpm run generate:social-cards
scripts.lint: find app lib scripts test -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 node scripts/check-js-syntax.mjs
scripts.start: pnpm run prepare && node scripts/dev-server.mjs next start
scripts.dev:app: pnpm run prepare && node scripts/dev-server.mjs next dev
